ارتعدت (form VIII)
# اِرْتَعَدْتُ (irtaʕadtu) /ir.ta.ʕad.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِرْتَعَدَ (irtaʕada)
# اِرْتَعَدْتَ (irtaʕadta) /ir.ta.ʕad.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِرْتَعَدَ (irtaʕada)
# اِرْتَعَدْتِ (irtaʕadti) /ir.ta.ʕad.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِرْتَعَدَ (irtaʕada)
# اِرْتَعَدَتْ (irtaʕadat) /ir.ta.ʕa.dat/: third-perso
